I have a feeling NSA was doing this kind of stuff for a very long time, but just now thanks to all the possible ways of sharing data we are capable of learning this through various channels.

In a world with advancement technology and with forms of governments which gather power for specific and unspecific reasons; there is absolutely no way how to remove anything like NSA in the future for any country on this Earth. We can reform NSA and US government all we want, but another group of people within the government will be created. It is literally unstoppable, unless the form of how we govern people is completely changed to something different.

There are some ideas, better than democracy (still the best of the worst government forms). But to this day no country on this lovely blue planet ever tested them, nationwide. Maybe some experiments with certain amount of people and computer analysis. But that's far, far from the real thing.

Until we, as humanity, can actually learn how to do this, nationwide, or better planetwide, we should understand there will be always groups like NSA, Snowdens and Wikileaks, all showing how privacy is pretty much non existential in our times. Sadly, the important part is to remember it was always like that, because the democracy is still the best thing we could ever come up with as humans and it always creates problems like NSA. The only difference is that modern technology makes everything more visible, more is shared, more people understand.

More people are scared.

It is proper and "good fight" to fight off groups like NSA and keep our fundamental privacy rights, but in a larger scale, it will be always just a short burst of freedom in an ocean of never-ending chains. Until, we all humans, figure out a better way how to govern ourselves.
